transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Since I watched that car get crushed in front of me last week, I’ve gone out of my way to avoid driving or even being near busy intersections. I witnessed a horrific crash right in front of me, and I'm just too shaken up to get behind the wheel anymore.

Since the crash happened last week, have you also been having unwanted memories, nightmares, or feeling like you’re reliving it? And have these symptoms lasted more than a month or is it only since the event last week?

Yes, during the day I'll suddenly see that car flipping in vivid detail out of nowhere—even while just making coffee—and my chest clamps up like I'm back on the roadside. At night, I lie awake replaying the crash over and over instead of sleeping, and all of this only started right after the accident last week, so it hasn't been a month.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient developed acute trauma-related symptoms immediately after witnessing a horrific motor vehicle crash last week, including intrusive recollections, physiologic distress when reminded, avoidance of driving/intersections, and sleep disturbance. The duration is clearly less than 1 month, supporting an acute stress reaction rather than a longer-duration trauma disorder.
